'''Company E''' was a [[Company/Legends|company]] of snipers of the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref> They were a unit of the elite [[Four Hundred and Third|403rd]], and thus a part of the [[Imperial sniper corps]].<ref name="Deceived" />

[[Vrath Xizor]] claimed to have been deployed as a sniper on special detachment from Company E.<ref name="Deceived" />
